edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $425,000, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, plus eligibility to participate in the Company’s benefit plans as in effect from time to time, subject to the terms of those plans.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Executive’s employment is terminated by the Company without Cause or by the Executive for Good Reason, and subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims, the Executive shall receive: (a) a severance amount equal to 18 months of Base Salary, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices; and (b) continued Company-paid health-benefit coverage during the 18-month severance period, to the extent permitted by applicable law and the terms of the applicable plans.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. The Executive shall comply with customary confidentiality obligations with respect to the Company’s confidential information and, for 12 months following termination of employment, shall not solicit for employment any employee of the Company with whom the Executive had material business contact during the final 12 months of employment. The parties shall not make knowingly false statements that disparage the other party; provided that this mutual non-disparagement covenant shall not restrict truthful statements required by law, legal process, or governmental inquiry. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits or restricts either party from reporting possible violations of law or regulation to, communicating with, filing a charge or complaint with, participating in any investigation or proceeding conducted by, or otherwise cooperating with any governmental agency or self-regulatory organization, or from exercising any rights protected under applicable law. The prior non-compete covenant is deleted in its entirety.
edits.name: Restrictive Covenants
